style: Photorealistic tall old-growth eucalyptus forest in the early morning, pale towering trunks, a lush fern understorey and a small creek, golden sunbeams slanting through mist
continuity: the framing, horizon and every landmark remain fixed and the scene settles into the framing shown in Picture 2 at the end of the shot, matching the first frame so the clip can loop.
ambience: A quiet forest morning with birdsong and a trickling creek

segments.camera: The camera holds a locked-off static wide shot.
segments.action: Golden sunbeams slant through slowly drifting mist, the small creek trickles over stones, the fern fronds sway gently and leaves high in the canopy flutter in a light breeze. The tree trunks stay still.
